sql_query:
CREATE TABLE inv_item AS SELECT
    t2.*,
    t1.genericmaterialcode,
    t1.familycode,
    t1.divisioncode,
    t1.producttypecode
FROM itemmaster t1
JOIN df_inv_2 t2
    ON t1.variantmaterialcode = t2.itemid
   AND t1.seasonid = t2.seasonid;
